verdict.rationale: Glama ships its own chat assistant (glama.ai/chat). It gives access to leading models, answers questions about uploaded documents with page references, and turns text descriptions into diagrams, so users can hand some tasks to a built-in AI. The evidence shows Q&A and generation tasks rather than agentic, multi-step delegation. The pricing page's 'automate workflows' line is not tied to the assistant. Missing for 10: evidence the assistant executes multi-step or agentic tasks (e.g., using MCP tools or acting on the user's Glama resources), integration of the assistant with the MCP hosting/gateway features, in-depth docs, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Access every leading model with a single account. Same familiar UI, powerful features, no limits.
Upload any PDF, Word doc, or text file. Get instant answers with exact page references.
Transform text descriptions into professional diagrams.
